outputs.patientText: Pelvic pain that keeps coming back or lasts for months is worth discussing with your doctor.
outputs.clinicianText: Persistent or recurrent pelvic pain reported (duration: {pelvic_pain_duration_months:months}).

outputs.patientText: Period-related pain that affects your day-to-day life is worth discussing with your doctor.
outputs.clinicianText: Period-related pain with functional impact reported (misses {missed_activity}; days per month: {missed_days_per_month}).

outputs.patientText: Pain during or after sex is something clinicians ask about. It is worth mentioning.
outputs.clinicianText: Pain during or after sex reported (depth not specified).

outputs.patientText: Bowel or bladder pain that comes with your periods is worth mentioning to your doctor.
outputs.clinicianText: Bowel or urinary pain around periods reported.

outputs.patientText: Trouble conceiving for a year or more is worth discussing with your doctor.
If pain relief from painkillers is limited, your doctor can discuss other options.
outputs.clinicianText: Limited relief from first-line painkillers reported ({analgesic_response}).
